content.text: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: final portrait slot cabinet background for a mobile game. Image 1 is the edit target. Image 2 is only a control-layout clarity reference; do not copy its cabinet shape, colors, title, reels, ornaments or symbols. Modify only the lower physical control-deck area of Image 1, approximately source pixels y=1020 to y=1260. Keep the jade roof, title marquee, jackpot display, 5x3 reel window, black credits readout, jade side columns, red lower body, outer silhouette, camera, scale, lighting and all geometry outside that deck unchanged with maximum fidelity. Rebuild the emerald-jade and champagne-gold control deck as a visibly taller, softly sloped two-tier physical console integrated into the cabinet. Exactly seven blank functional button faces, no extra buttons: upper primary row has TURBO face near x=160 y=1128, one dominant circular SPIN face near x=512 y=1144, AUTO face near x=864 y=1128; lower utility row has two wide metal faces near x=275 and x=415 y=1200 for paytable and rules, plus two smaller separated round faces near x=640 and x=745 y=1200 for bet minus and bet plus. Make upper faces about 105x78 pixels, spin about 112 pixels diameter, utility faces about 120x54 pixels, small bet faces about 58x54 pixels. Button caps must be blank and dark enough for runtime icons and labels, with real recessed sockets, engraved jade-gold rims, soft edge light and distinct spacing. Preserve the warm jade, peach-red and champagne-gold luxury; festive high-end casino, not solemn. Do not add readable text, labels, UI overlays, extra reels, logos, watermark, duplicate controls or floating buttons. Output one complete 1024x1536 image.
